name: web-accessibility-practice
description: 웹 접근성 실습을 위한 단계별 프로젝트

scripts.start: echo '사용 가능한 명령어:' && echo 'npm run step1 - 1단계 서버 실행 (포트 3001)' && echo 'npm run step2 - 2단계 서버 실행 (포트 3002)' && echo 'npm run step3 - 3단계 서버 실행 (포트 3003)' && echo 'npm run step4 - 4단계 서버 실행 (포트 3004)' && echo 'npm run all - 모든 단계 동시 실행' && echo 'npm run audit:step1 - 1단계 Lighthouse 자동 검사' && echo 'npm run audit:all - 전체 단계 Lighthouse 자동 검사'
scripts.step1: echo '🔴 1단계 서버 시작 - http://localhost:3001' && http-server step1-problems -p 3001 -o -c-1
scripts.step2: echo '🟡 2단계 서버 시작 - http://localhost:3002' && http-server step2-basic-fix -p 3002 -o -c-1
scripts.step3: echo '🟢 3단계 서버 시작 - http://localhost:3003' && http-server step3-good-practice -p 3003 -o -c-1
scripts.step4: echo '🔥 4단계 서버 시작 - http://localhost:3004' && http-server step4-advanced -p 3004 -o -c-1
scripts.all: concurrently "npm run step1:bg" "npm run step2:bg" "npm run step3:bg" "npm run step4:bg" && echo '모든 서버가 시작되었습니다!'
scripts.lighthouse:all: echo '모든 단계에 대해 Lighthouse 검사를 실행합니다...' && npm run lighthouse:step1 && npm run lighthouse:step2 && npm run lighthouse:step3 && npm run lighthouse:step4
scripts.audit:step1: start-server-and-test "npm run step1:bg" http://localhost:3001 "npm run lighthouse:step1"
scripts.audit:step2: start-server-and-test "npm run step2:bg" http://localhost:3002 "npm run lighthouse:step2"
scripts.audit:step3: start-server-and-test "npm run step3:bg" http://localhost:3003 "npm run lighthouse:step3"
scripts.audit:step4: start-server-and-test "npm run step4:bg" http://localhost:3004 "npm run lighthouse:step4"
scripts.audit:all: mkdir -p reports && npm run audit:step1 && npm run audit:step2 && npm run audit:step3 && npm run audit:step4
scripts.setup: npm install && mkdir -p reports && echo '설정이 완료되었습니다!'

author: Web Accessibility Practice
